jobs.objective: REVISE the v1 RFC 0168 P0 SPEC to discharge the TWO binding cycle-1 constraints, carrying forward UNREGRESSED everything v1 cleared. Start from the v1 HOLDER.md (a required context doc) — do NOT rewrite from scratch; the v1 cycle-1 COLLABORATION_LEDGER (also required) gives the exact prescribed fixes. CARRY FORWARD UNREGRESSED (v1 PROVEN, do NOT reopen): the structural hard core HC-A1..A5 (a per-lane uid dissolves BC1-W1-ORACLE on this host under Yama ptrace_scope=1 — distinct run-as uids land on tmux's per-uid 0700 socket; a different uid fails ptrace_may_access for ptrace/setns//proc; a 0600/0700 lane-owned file is cross-uid-unreadable; SO_PEERCRED uid discriminator), OQ1 (host-global pool sizing + typed fail-closed refuse-and-requeue default), OQ3 (static host-runbook pool; daemon holds only the launch-as `(%striatum-lanes)` grant, NO useradd/userdel authority), OQ5 (leased-uid + monotonic generation token anti-recycle), OQ6 (per-spawn per-uid hydration with scrub-on-return), and the NARROWING invariant (no admin-token widening, no lane-readable shared reseal bearer). DISCHARGE C1 (OQ2 lease lifecycle — verdict-driving): the durable lease state machine cannot represent a returned-but-dirty uid. v1 schema is only `state active|returned`; prose relies on an unrepresented `quarantined`; the free predicate is `no active lease row`; `mark returned only after scrub 1-3 succeed` rests on command exit codes (`kill -KILL -1`==0 does NOT prove an empty per-uid kill domain; a process can survive/reappear/recreate HOME files after the command returns). A scrub failure forces a state the table cannot express → re-lease a dirty uid (same-uid cross-lease residue leak, the exact class 0168 must eliminate) OR a zombie-active lease with no recovery path, no doctor surface, false exhaustion accounting. The revised SPEC must specify: a durable `scrubbing`/`quarantined` state in the lease schema; an allocation/scrub TRANSACTION boundary; a scrub POSTCONDITION proof (prove the per-uid kill domain is empty + HOME/cred-store/tmux-server scrubbed, not just exit==0); the leaked / failed-scrub REAPER recovery path; a doctor surface for a quarantined uid; and exhaustion accounting (OQ1) that EXCLUDES quarantined uids from the free set. DISCHARGE C2 (OQ4 ACL over-grant — verdict-driving): the recursive DEFAULT group ACL `setfacl -R -m g:striatum-lanes:rX <repo>` over the repo ROOT reaches `.striatum/` — daemon/operator-private control-plane (the 0600 MCP bearer at `.striatum/scratch`, mcpconfig.go:550-571; PTY logs; token cache; foreign worktrees). scratch_acl.go:31-48 grants `.striatum` only `u:<lane>:--x` traverse under a `never broaden read access to private operator state` invariant; the whole-group `g:striatum-lanes:rX -R` breaks it (a pool uid not leased to this repo gets group read on another lane's session-bound bearer; `-R ...:rX` adds group `r` even to existing 0600 files). The revised SPEC must specify: an ACL grant that EXCLUDES `.striatum/` (preserve the `u:<lane>:--x` traverse-only carve-out), grants exactly-enough to the LEASED uid without over-granting unleased pool uids, plus a load-bearing test asserting `.striatum/`/MCP-config/PTY-log/foreign-worktree NON-exposure to an unleased pool uid. Open the revised SPEC with an auditable 'Addressing the v1 constraints' map (C1 RESOLVED how, C2 RESOLVED how, carry-forwards INTACT). Keep the local-first boundary. This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.
